jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT TESSERA LABS Tessera Labs is a new category of enterprise software: an AI platform that changes how the world's largest companies run. Every large enterprise carries the same weight — decades of accumulated process, data, and code that no longer match the business it has become. Changing any of it is a program measured in years and hundreds of millions of dollars, staffed by armies of consultants, and it fails more often than anyone admits. Most companies have quietly accepted this as the cost of being large. We don't. Tessera is a transformation engine: a governed, multi-agent platform that understands an enterprise's process, data, and code as one connected system and changes it in weeks rather than years. We're vendor-agnostic by design — SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Oracle, Snowflake, MuleSoft — and tied to none of them. Two things make this hard, and they're the reason the job is interesting. Governance: every action is logged, traceable, and reversible, because our customers are regulated and these are the systems that close their books. And generality: the platform has to work on landscapes it has never seen, at companies whose complexity is genuinely unique to them. We sell a product, not a service. Our people are here to make the product successful, not the other way around. If you've watched enterprise AI companies quietly become consultancies, that distinction is the one to press us on. You'll turn business questions into precise, testable requirements, then use the data itself to prove out what's possible: profiling sources, validating assumptions, and shaping designs that are clean, buildable, and grounded in evidence rather than opinion. You'll own the requirements and analysis for your use cases and workstreams, working in close partnership with Business Solution Managers who hold the broader engagement. Doing that well takes two things at once: command of healthcare business context, and deep, hands-on fluency in the data. This is a client-facing role. You'll translate complex healthcare challenges into rigorous requirements, and you'll use SQL and analytical judgment to show clients and delivery teams what the data actually says, where it falls short, and what that means for the design. No engagement lives in isolation. jobs.description_text: Please note we are looking for someone who is willing and able to come into our downtown Toronto office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week). YOUR ROLE We're hiring a Senior Product Manager (experience dependent) to lead Zip's Contract Orchestration product, one of the company's newest and most strategic bets. Buy-side contracting is still broken: reviews and redlines live in email threads, signed agreements disappear into shared drives, and requesters call the process a black box. Zip's customers execute over a million contract reviews a year and most of them are routine agreements. We just launched AI Contract Orchestration to take that work off legal and procurement, and there is far more to build. You'll own the vision and strategy for one or more areas of this product, end to end and with a high degree of autonomy. The category is established, but Zip has an edge: as the front door for procurement, we see every contract with clean intake data on the requester, spend, category, and risk, so our AI can review clauses, propose redlines, and route work on real context rather than the document alone. As PM, you'll balance different users' interests throughout the contracting process (procurement, legal, finance, requesters, suppliers), and you'll own the quality bar that lets legal trust AI with language that carries real liability. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Product Design at Zip is a tight-knit team that cares deeply about craft, collaboration, and building consumer-grade experiences for complex enterprise workflows. We build on Birch, our design system, and we use AI across how we design and build. Procure-to-Pay (P2P) spans a wide scope:: purchase orders, invoices, and payments, and the workflows that keep enterprise spend committed and accurate. It is also where Zip's next five years take shape: we believe every dollar of enterprise spend can be orchestrated, automated, and optimized by Zip, and P2P is where those dollars are committed and paid. You'll join an established team with a dedicated PM, a strong engineering group, and direct lines to the customers you're designing for. You'll work in a highly collaborative environment with designers, engineers, and product managers who care deeply about craft and are obsessed with delivering a great experience for our customers.
